title: Gradient family on outdoor posters
slide_intent: Hold composition steady while varying color so a viewer can compare a palette’s expressive range.
strategic_value: Repeated O2 marks and layouts can keep outdoor panels connected even when their gradients differ.
demonstration: Six adjacent outdoor panels repeat a large O2 mark and small baseline copy over gradients that vary in lightness and lower accent hue.
practical_value: Compare mark/background contrast across a family of color variants before applying them to a series.

content_islands.name: Street context
content_islands.spec: Keep the paving, bridge structure and cast shadows around the row of panels.

content_islands.name: Six-panel comparison
content_islands.spec: Align the O2 signatures and bottom copy across six equal panels, varying the gradient and switching the mark between blue and white where shown.

ingredient.name: Gradient poster field
ingredient.role: Give a repeated brand composition variation without changing its structure.
ingredient.application: Keep the logo and copy in repeated positions while selecting a contrasting blue or white mark for each field.
ingredient.scope: Observed six-poster mockup in the 2023 refresh; the examples do not establish numerical contrast thresholds.

reference_purposes.Expression: Six gradients vary from pale blue to warm, green and cyan accents.
reference_purposes.Application: The repeated signature and baseline copy demonstrate the palette in an outdoor poster series.
